description_en: Retrieves all inspection reports for a specified scheduled task. You can filter the results by time range and use pagination
description_zh: 查询指定定时任务下的所有巡检报告列表，支持按时间范围过滤和分页
name: GetScheduledReports

parameters.description_en: The ID of the inspection task.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the inspection task
parameters.name: scheduled_id

parameters.description_en: The start time of the query range. The time must be in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format.
parameters.description_zh: 开始时间过滤（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ），不传则不过滤。
parameters.help_en: The start time of the query range. The time must be in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
parameters.help_zh: 开始时间过滤（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ），不传则不过滤
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.description_en: The end time of the query range. The time must be in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format.
parameters.description_zh: 结束时间过滤（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ），不传则不过滤。
parameters.help_en: The end time of the query range. The time must be in the YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ format
parameters.help_zh: 结束时间过滤（格式：YYYY-MM-DDTHH:mm:ssZ），不传则不过滤
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.description_en: The page number. The default value is 1.
parameters.help_en: The page number. The default value is 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.description_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20, and the maximum value is 100.
parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. The default value is 20, and the maximum value is 100
parameters.name: page_size
